title: Bank import is isolated per budget: the same bank transaction imports into every budget that links the account
description: After budget-1iym (v2026.11.23) the Itaú sync shows '967 skipped: already imported in another budget'. Budgets are isolated: the same connection feeding accounts in two budgets must import into both. Root cause: connection_transactions unique (provider, external_transaction_id) is global (0014_connections.sql:72) and findImportedBankId in api/src/connections/sync.ts searches every budget.
notes:
syscd-app (main e992160) has no code reading/writing connection_transactions (connections removed in its 4d5cde2), so 0106 drops the global unique (provider, external_transaction_id) and adds connection_transactions.budget_id (backfill, NOT NULL, BEFORE INSERT trigger fills it from transactions) + unique index (budget_id, provider, external_transaction_id). sync.ts: findImportedBankId scoped to acc.budget_id; skipped_accounts always same-budget, named. skippedOtherBudget string + client branch removed (old null-name entries hidden). New DB tests in api/src/connections/sync-per-budget.test.ts; sync-idempotent updated. Note: accounts_link_unique allows one budget account per (connection, upstream account) at a time, so the production case is a relink into another budget; tests cover that plus two connections sharing bank ids. tsc/eslint/bun test green in shared/api/client.
landed outside tk close at 34af37a (branch tk/budget-mwp0 merged into main by hand)
Merged to main and released in v2026.11.23-02 (branch 8d04e54): bank-id identity per budget; migration 0106 adds connection_transactions.budget_id (backfill, NOT NULL, fill trigger), drops global unique, adds unique (budget_id, provider, external_transaction_id); 'another budget' skip removed. shared 167, api 1212, client 1246 pass. User approved merge+deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Bank-id identity scoped to the budget: skip only when the id exists (live or deleted) in the SAME budget; another budget imports its own copy. Unique key per budget (provider, external id, budget) with backfill; syscd-app shares this DB and inserts connection_transactions, so the change must not break it (check its code). Skip banner never says 'another budget' again. Tests: two budgets linking the same upstream account both import; same-budget deleted/other-account skip still works; re-run is a no-op. All packages green.

commits.subject: connections: bank-id identity is per budget; the same bank transaction imports into every budget that links it (budget-mwp0)
